lines.trans: Kostya, she and I were too different.
Why do you think so, my friend?
She considered me a real coward.
But I did not want to jump with a parachute!
Why stupidly risk one's life at all?
I completely agree with you.
She dumped me right here yesterday.
What is going on here at the bar?
Where is the restroom located here, tell me?
The restroom is located immediately to the left of the bar.
Friend, you need hot soup right now!
I am not at all against tasty soup.
Kostya, urgently order bouillabaisse for our guest!

meanings.en: to leave, to walk out on (someone)

examples.trans: Kostya ordered hot bouillabaisse for the guest.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
The bread rings are very tasty.
I have no idea at all.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)
hot (to the touch, of food/drink, not weather)

examples.trans: Careful, the cup is very hot.

meanings.note: at home, a party, or a restaurant

examples.trans: All the guests love them very much.

examples.text: Сегодня вечером к нам придут гости.
examples.trans: Guests are coming to our place tonight.
This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

meanings.note: думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

находиться.gloss: to be located, to be found

meanings.en: to be located, to be situated

examples.trans: Where is the operating room located?
The town is situated on a river.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

meanings.note: short form 'нужен / нужна / нужно / нужны' + dative: 'мне нужна работа' = I need a job
canopy device to slow descent through the air

examples.trans: He refused to jump with a parachute.

подсказать.gloss: to tell, to suggest, to give directions

meanings.en: to tell, to direct, to suggest
meanings.note: to provide helpful information or prompt someone

examples.trans: Could you tell me where the restroom is located?
Marina Sergeyevna has paid off the debt in full.
Why are we going so slowly?

meanings.en: to happen, take place, go on
meanings.note: Что происходит? = What is going on?

examples.trans: What is going on? I don't understand.

meanings.note: + genitive; can stand alone: Я против = I'm against it

meanings.en: to hop in, to jump in (a car)

examples.trans: The children are jumping in the courtyard.

рисковать.gloss: to risk, to take a risk

meanings.en: to risk, to take a risk
meanings.note: чем я рискую? = what have I got to lose?

examples.trans: What have I got to lose?
There's no need to take risks.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми
refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

слева.gloss: on the left, to the left

meanings.en: on the left, to the left

examples.trans: The restroom is located to the left of the bar.

examples.text: Я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: That's not what I mean at all.

meanings.note: almost always the short form: я согласен (man), я согласна (woman)

examples.trans: You can see it at once.

meanings.en: urgently, right away; predicative: it is urgent

examples.trans: I need to make a phone call urgently.

examples.text: Костя протёр барную стойку чистым полотенцем.
examples.trans: Kostya wiped the bar counter with a clean towel.

считать.gloss: to count; to think, to consider

meanings.note: я считаю, что... = I think that...
at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?
The toilet is in the corridor.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: If you don't want to, suit yourself.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
